title: Agentic Superoptimization of Bioimaging Analysis Workflows
venue: LLM for Scientific Discovery: Reasoning, Assistance, and Collaboration

publication.venue: LLM for Scientific Discovery: Reasoning, Assistance, and Collaboration

mechanism.domainTask: Bioimaging preprocessing-function search for Polaris, Cellpose, and MedSAM workflows
mechanism.populationDetail: An undivided function bank stores many generated preprocessing functions and scores; no islands or tree are maintained.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No separate in-loop elite archive is specified; top-K validation selection is downstream reporting.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The function bank is append-only and apparently unbounded; top-K filtering is applied after rollouts for test evaluation.
mechanism.generationDetail: The coding agent independently proposes new preprocessing functions; historical functions are contextual examples rather than editable parents.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Execution feedback and numerical workflow scores are returned to the coding agent and stored with functions; exact failure payload is under-specified.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: No true parent is selected; bank samples are contextual references.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Append-only function-bank memory with top-and-bottom contextual sampling combined with independent batch generation and a fixed explore/refine phase schedule.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/Agentic Superoptimization of Bioimaging Analysis Workflows.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Current survey appears to omit flat-bank/incremental-insertion and from-scratch-generation placements; do not treat contextual bank samples as true parents or as a multi-elite archive. Metadata feedback is medium confidence because the exact execution-feedback payload is not fully exposed.
